concept.title: NIGHT PULSE
concept.description: A high-energy Japanese-style commercial for a premium dark chocolate bar. Urban night, fast rhythmic cuts, bold English typography, and a clear narrative of stress-to-power transformation.

identity.name: PULSE
identity.material: Matte black wrapper with sharp silver edges
identity.color: Deep black packaging, dark chocolate interior
identity.logo: Minimalist bold wordmark PULSE in pure white
identity.details: Thin rectangular bar, clean break lines, no extra graphics

camera_direction.camera_journey: Rapid hard cuts every 1-1.5 seconds. Mix of extreme close-ups on the product, dynamic handheld urban shots, and clean beauty orbits around the chocolate bar. High energy, never static.

visual_style.overall: Modern Japanese commercial aesthetic with English typography
visual_style.materials_and_texture: Glossy wet streets, matte black packaging, sharp reflections, high contrast, crisp commercial finish

beats.description: Fast urban night cuts. Young person walking through neon Tokyo-style streets, looking exhausted. Hard flashes of light.
Close-up hand pulls the PULSE bar from a pocket. Sharp product beauty shot. Wrapper tears cleanly.
Extreme close-up of the first bite. Chocolate breaks with perfect texture. Eyes light up.
